role: one switchable hero-tree candidate in the Chapter 2 round-3 comparison lab
technique: topology-eroded prior: a model-free anisotropic chamfer geodesic erodes one mature plate into nine growth priors, each redrawn by img2img so the silhouette sets topology and the model supplies the younger-tree detail

anchorRegistration.appliedRule: alpha-weighted x across bottom three occupied rows; bottom-most occupied y
anchorRegistration.appliedRuleSource: round-1's accepted track (assets/chapter2-organic-pose-to-pose/tree-registration.json), re-derived here and verified to reproduce that track's (96,188) on all nine accepted frames
anchorRegistration.experimentDeclaredRule: contact-row centroid over the bottom 10 rows, alpha threshold 32 (work/registration.json)
anchorRegistration.registeredAnchorClaim: every frame's alpha-weighted contact x lies within maxAnchorResidualPx of the registered integer anchor, and its bottom-most occupied row IS the registered y exactly. Stated as a BOUND rather than an equality because a frame can land exactly on the 0.5 tie, where round-to-nearest is not a total function and Python (half-to-even) and JavaScript (half-up) disagree; at a tie the registration prefers not to move the art.

costOfApplyingTheAppliedRule.note: Re-pinning to the ground contact under round-1's rule moves the tree body by this much. Where 'after' is worse than 'before', the experiment's own band was averaging a wider part of the base and was more stable for the BODY even though it was not measuring the CONTACT.

tracks.prompt: the same tree at an earlier age, redrawn as a complete healthy young tree, same root, same palette: keep this exact trunk, branch fork and root contact, and turn the flat green mass into a real leafy canopy of layered round moss-green and olive leaf clusters growing directly out of these branches, rounded soft branch tips, one continuously connected organism with no gap or seam between trunk and leaves, storybook pixel art, transparent background, no ground, no soil, no grass, no shadow, no frame, no border, exactly one tree

redraws.model: PixelLab create_image_pixflux img2img (init_image prior + color_image palette lock); init_image_strength ramped from the measured synthetic-crown area
redraws.seedNote: one seed for the whole track, so the model's noise field is identical frame to frame

tracks.sharedWith: every candidate in the lab, and with chapter2-organic-pose-to-pose-v1
tracks.note: FIXED across the lab (ADR-0277 D2 retained cutout/pose plant track). Registered here by reference, not copied, so a candidate swap cannot change the plant.

authoringRejects.reason: mature plate carried a grass tuft and green soil patch; ADR-0274 D1/D6 forbid land
bare-wood prior probe (strength 380): model returned a cleaned-up bare tree, not a leafy young one

authoringRejects.jobId: whole passes v1 (seed 31830), v2 (31840), v3 (31850 flat strength), v4-00..02 (31850)
authoringRejects.reason: superseded passes: smooth-blob priors / discrete-ball crowns / a three-band flat slab at frame 04 / early cuts that left frame 00 as a leaf tuft on a stump

knownWeakness: the root footprint never grows: the contact band is the geodesic seed, so frame 00 wears the mature tree's full root flare (78 px wide under a 55 px tall tree) and reads as 'young tree beside old roots'. The experiment records a measured attempt to fix it that broke the anchor by 23 px.

appOwns: world sockets, depth slots and painter order
app-native SVG coast and ground reveal
the even progress mapping across the delivered frame order

budget.ceilingPolicy: the restated ceiling IS the measured actual - zero headroom by design, so adding a byte, a frame or a layer fails validation rather than sliding through
budget.mountedAtOnce: ONE hero-tree track over the one shared plant track. The other three candidates are checked in but are never decoded in the same session.

referencePlateNote: NONE. The track was generated in isolation against its own mature plate (raw/mature-b-efcd8090-00.png). The experiment records that create_map_object was never pulled, so this tree has never been drawn at the real island camera or in the island palette.
